title: Eastern Style Avocado Stir Fry
description: A delicious and healthy stir fry dish inspired by Eastern cuisine, featuring velvety tofu and creamy avocado.
instructions: Heat the stir fry oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the green onions and cook for 1 minute, until wilted.
Add the avocado and cook for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Sprinkle the middle eastern spice blend over the top and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Eastern Style Avocado Stir Fry!
